scope: Release security and supply-chain gate covering network, document, rendering, filesystem, credential, account, approval, dependency, license, and vendor-lock boundaries

red_evidence.reason: symlink escape, event-handler XSS, forged approval, and missing release-audit assertions failed while established SSRF, malicious-document, secret, and wrong-account boundaries passed

assertions: SSRF redirects to private and link-local targets are rejected before the next request
DOCX external relationships are rejected without network resolution
script, dangerous-protocol, event-handler, and srcdoc XSS forms are rejected
an authorized export root is mandatory and symlink resolution cannot escape it
credential sentinels do not enter result objects, logs, or mismatch details
wrong remote account identity remains blocked
forged or structurally invalid approval records cannot authorize remote delivery
runtime dependencies are exact-version pinned and present in third-party notices
vendor tags, commits, directory hashes, notices, and license evidence pass offline and upstream checks
the host-provided shell remains an explicit trust boundary rather than a claimed absolute sandbox

review.kind: separate primary-agent review because delegated review is disabled by session policy
